title: inspect_trace (MCP) still diagnoses death runs as no_failure — src/mcp/tools.ts:862
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

Same one-line fix I applied to bin/inspect.ts (`diagnose(rules, trace.initial_state, trace.actions, { isWinningEnding: id => index.pack.endings.find(e => e.id === id)?.death !== true })`), but src/mcp/tools.ts belongs to the MCP subsystem owner. The MCP surface is the more-used of the two production call sites, so this is worth picking up there.
